title: Two Iran-linked Ships Passed Through Strait of Hormuz Ahead of U.S. Blockade
partialText: The vessels exited the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, hours before a U.S. naval blockade took effect.

title: Southwest Airlines Imposes Further Limits on Portable Chargers on Flights
